verdict.rationale: Airweave lets a developer search a whole collection of synced sources through a single endpoint to retrieve relevant context for agents. Its agentic search mode also builds a comprehensive result set. However, nothing in the evidence shows the results are assembled into a prompt-ready context block or capped to a token budget, so only the one-call relevant-retrieval part of the story is supported. Missing for 10: token-budget parameter or truncation, prompt-ready formatted context block output, memory-style (session or user) recall rather than synced-document search, hands-on corroboration.
